title: Promoting my Stream and Game - Elemental Kingdom

posts.author: Nomi
posts.body:
Hey folks! I recently got back into the RPG Maker and came back to a teenage project of mine.
I started to stream that progress on Twitch and also tried to find fellow "RPG Maker Streamers" ... sadly the amound is rare, basically non existent!
Therefore I would like to promote my stream a bit, be welcome at my place and chill with me while working on your own project or watch me working on mine! I also wanna encourage others to start streaming about their game, really expected more rpg maker stuff on Twitch. Here is a link to my stream ... ofc it's not all about RPG Maker. But recently quite often! My origin is german, but I can switch to english if you notify me in the chat.
=========================
=========================
Additionally to that I would like to present my Project, currently called
Elemental Kingdom
!
The game will be a classic Fantasy RPG, very oldschool as I'm a big fan of the world of might and magic and silimiar settings.
It's mainly using a mix of RPG Maker assets modified or combined with 2d drawing. Ofc there are also other assets included, for example sprites created/modified by the talented Panda Maru.
I hope to turn it into a commercial project sooner or later. But it started out as a project I did beside school in RPG Maker Vx Ace. Right now I managed to port some of it over to MZ. And soon I try to expand it and maybe finish it one day. If you wanna support me I would really appreciate to have you around! There is no steam page or patreon or anything like that yet... but it might follow. Feel free to tell me if you would also support me on such platforms! That would certainly motivate me to speed up the process
Another picture to show some mood. Have a nice day and be sure to give me a visit!
... and let me know if you would enjoy more streams and infos.
